texto.es: Nos cuentas que sintomas tiene tu carro. Sin formularios ni apps de reserva, solo una linea directa al taller.
texto.en: Tell us what symptoms your car is showing. No forms, no booking app, just a direct line to the shop.

texto.es: Revisamos el carro en persona y te explicamos exactamente que necesita y por que, antes de empezar cualquier trabajo.
texto.en: We look at the vehicle in person and walk you through exactly what it needs and why, before any work starts.

texto.es: Te damos un precio claro para la reparacion, tal como dice el nombre del taller: sin sorpresas una vez el carro ya esta en el elevador.
texto.en: You get a clear price for the repair, matching the shop's name: no surprises once the car is already on the lift.

texto.es: Tecnicos certificados ASE hacen el trabajo y te devuelven el carro, con el mismo tiempo de respuesta rapido que mencionan los clientes en Google.
texto.en: ASE certified technicians do the work and hand the car back, with the same quick turnaround customers mention on Google.

nota.es: Cada reparacion se cotiza despues de revisar tu carro en persona. Llamanos y te damos el detalle sin compromiso.
nota.en: Every repair is quoted after we take a look at your vehicle in person. Call the shop and we will walk you through it, no strings attached.

texto.es: Recarga de freon, instalacion y reparacion de aire acondicionado, y trabajo en bomba de combustible: la especialidad detras del letrero 'A.C. Specialist' en la fachada.
texto.en: Freon refills, A/C installation and repair, and fuel pump work, the specialty behind the 'A.C. Specialist' sign out front.

texto.es: Servicio de frenos, cambios de aceite, afinaciones y trabajo electrico para que tu carro de uso diario siga siendo confiable.
texto.en: Brake service, oil changes, tune-ups and electrical work for daily drivers that need to stay reliable.

texto.es: Servicio de llantas, trabajo de suspension y alineacion de ruedas en el propio equipo Hunter del taller.
texto.en: Tire service, suspension work and wheel alignment on the shop's own Hunter alignment rack.

texto.es: Ford, Chevrolet, Toyota, Honda, Nissan, Kia, Hyundai, Lexus, Volkswagen, y marcas europeas como Mercedes-Benz, BMW y Audi.
texto.en: Ford, Chevrolet, Toyota, Honda, Nissan, Kia, Hyundai, Lexus, Volkswagen and European makes like Mercedes-Benz, BMW and Audi.

pie.es: ¿No ves tu problema en la lista? Llama igual: la mayoria de los trabajos aqui empiezan con un diagnostico rapido por telefono.
pie.en: Do not see your issue listed? Call anyway: most repairs here start with a quick diagnostic over the phone.

items.quote: My experience at Honest Auto Repair Center was outstanding! Sean and his staff were professional, friendly, and incredibly helpful from start to finish.

I stopped by Honest Auto Repair today to have my Honda's underbody splash guard secured after I had accidentally hit a median a few days prior. Met Reed who carefully explained to me the exact additional part I need for my vehicle's underbody to keep everything protected. Great Service!
Customer service excellent and quick with the service of my car. I will definitely return.
